items.title: Terrance Ferguson: Needs surgery, won't return from IR
items.text:
Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be reinstated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Avoids major ankle injury in Week 11
items.text:
Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Tuten aggravated a right ankle injury in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants, noting that an examination Monday revealed nothing "too bad," Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

items.title: Woody Marks: 'Trending in right direction' for Week 12
items.text:
Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Marks (concussion) is "trending in the right direction," and the Texans "are hopeful to have him" for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

items.title: Jalen Coker: Avoids concussion
items.text:
